name: Outzide layered HDR v2
base: Source-backed HDR photo with natural greens/blues and a slight burnt-orange shadow tint; source geography retained.
delivery: 2048px-wide WebP with640/1280 responsive variants; original and generation dimensions remain recorded in local authoring manifests.
overlay: Transparent SVG with offline semantic masks for orange sky nodes/wires, sparse small green tree nodes/wires and rainbow texture contours clipped to exposed terrain; selective water reflections. Decorative contours are not surveyed elevations.
fade: Stationary softly feathered burnt-orange gradient, bottom10percent.
motion: Fine-pointer parallax3px total. Node-only opacity glow for first20provisional popularity entries, maximum3visible per document. Paused offscreen, hidden, Calm/reduced-motion.

segmentation.execution: offlineauthoringonly; model weights and inference are not deployed

tools: Built-in imagegen enhancement; Sharp WebP/responsive delivery; offline semantic masks and SVG artwork.
